purpose: Turn Sage.js scope, correctness, workflow, and performance gaps into stable, independently claimable work lanes.

dimensions.scope: Reference APIs or mathematical cases that are implemented.
dimensions.correctness: Strength of semantic evidence, kept separate from breadth.
dimensions.workflow: Representative end-to-end research and teaching computations.
dimensions.performance: Time, memory, and scale compared under equivalent semantics.

systems.FLINT: Native exact-arithmetic implementation and performance reference.
systems.PARI/GP: Algebraic number theory and arithmetic reference.
systems.Magma: Research-scale algebra, number theory, curves, and modular forms reference.
systems.Oscar/Hecke/Nemo: Readable GPL implementations and performance references for algebra and number theory.
systems.NumPy/SciPy: Numerical array, linear-algebra, and quadrature references.
systems.igraph/bliss/nauty/OGDF: Graph algorithm, canonical-labeling, generation, layout, and performance references.

areas.scopeReference: Pinned language syntax, CLI behavior, Jupyter protocol messages, and platform matrix.
areas.competitiveTarget: Sage-compatible mathematics with CLI and notebook startup measured in milliseconds rather than seconds.

areas.scopeReference: Public parent/element APIs plus documented algebraic workflows.
areas.competitiveTarget: Sage-level breadth with native-kernel speed and readable high-level algorithms.

areas.scopeReference: Graph/DiGraph public APIs, graph families, exact certificates, database corpus, visualization workflows, and algorithmic scale.
areas.competitiveTarget: Broad Sage graph semantics with research-scale specialized kernels and excellent interactive visualization.

areas.scopeReference: Fields, orders, ideals, local data, class/unit groups, and Galois algorithms by degree and signature.
areas.competitiveTarget: Certified, readable general ANT that approaches PARI/Magma scale and benefits directly from FLINT.

areas.scopeReference: Documented arithmetic functions, local rings, characters, and analytic workflows.
areas.competitiveTarget: Broad Sage arithmetic semantics with automatic use of the fastest appropriate exact kernel.

areas.scopeReference: Curve, point, local/global invariant, isogeny, and arithmetic APIs by base field.
comparisonFocus: SageMath: integrated curve interfaces and databases
areas.competitiveTarget: Fast arithmetic and complete local/global workflows with explicit proof semantics.

areas.scopeReference: Spaces, symbols, Hecke actions, decompositions, forms, and q-expansions by level, weight, and character.
comparisonFocus: Magma: research-scale spaces and Hecke algorithms
areas.competitiveTarget: Readable exact algorithms competitive at research levels, weights, and characters.

areas.scopeReference: Operation-and-domain matrices rather than method-name counts alone.
comparisonFocus: NumPy/SciPy: numerical API breadth and kernels
areas.competitiveTarget: Reliable teaching and research workflows with explicit domains, branches, precision, and error estimates.

areas.scopeReference: Documented constructors, options, composition, display, export, and representative visual workflows.
areas.competitiveTarget: Most Sage plotting source works unchanged with excellent interactive display and credible publication export.

areas.scopeReference: CPython 3.14 public modules followed by per-module public API inventories.
comparisonFocus: CPython: complete API and behavioral reference
Node.js: host implementation primitives and cross-platform performance
areas.competitiveTarget: The high-value scientific and application stdlib works faithfully across native platforms, with unsupported boundaries explicit.

areas.scopeReference: Grammar nodes, language semantics, translated library calls, and real source corpora.
comparisonFocus: Original systems: syntax and semantic truth
Sage.js: shared runtime and cross-language notebook workflow
areas.competitiveTarget: Real mathematical source in several languages becomes executable, inspectable, and interoperable in one kernel.

areas.scopeReference: Supported platform, installation, relocation, signature, provenance, and update matrices.
comparisonFocus: Modern developer CLIs: one-command installation and updates
CPython/Jupyter: platform and kernel integration expectations
areas.competitiveTarget: A signed, relocatable mathematics executable and npm package that installs in one command everywhere.

areas.scopeReference: Audited capability manifests, independent oracles, benchmark coverage, and historical reproducibility.
comparisonFocus: Independent systems: semantic truth and speed baselines
Sage.js: transparent manifests, executable evidence, and historical trends
areas.competitiveTarget: Every material scope and performance claim is reproducible, versioned, and linked to executable evidence.
